metadata.question: In September 2023, did Cabo Frio have a sea zone of a temperature graident over 5 degrees Celcius over less than 10 kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Location: Cabo Frio (Brazil, ~22.88°S, 42.03°W) - Time: September 2023 - Data: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) from NOAA or similar thermal satellite - GEE Collections: NOAA/CDR/SST_WHOI for high-resolution SST data 2. Masking Strategy: - SST data is already processed for water bodies - No cloud masking needed for SST products (they handle this internally) - Focus on spatial gradient calculation over short distances (~10 km) 3. Logic to Distinguish: - Valid Zero (B): No temperature gradient >5°C within 10 km - Valid Result (A): Temperature gradient >5°C within <10 km exists - C1: No SST data for September 2023 - C2: Valid data exists but all pixels masked/invalid - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid temperature values - D: Collection name error, syntax issue, or method failure ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Cabo Frio region (Brazil) const caboFrio = ee.Geometry.Point([-42.03, -22.88]); const bufferZone = caboFrio.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer to capture gradients // 2. Acquire SST data for September 2023 const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_WHOI') .filterDate('2023-09-01', '2023-09-30') .filterBounds(bufferZone); const sstCount = sstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`September 2023 SST Images: ${sstCount}`); if (sstCount === 0) { // Try alternative SST dataset const altSst = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/AQUA/MYD28M') .filterDate('2023-09-01', '2023-09-30') .filterBounds(bufferZone); const altCount = altSst.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Alternative MODIS SST Images: ${altCount}`); if (altCount === 0) { console.log('No SST data found for September 2023 at Cabo Frio.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Use MODIS Aqua SST (more reliable for coastal zones) const sst = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/AQUA/MYD28M') .filterDate('2023-09-01', '2023-09-30') .filterBounds(bufferZone) .median(); // Composite for the month // 4. Check for valid pixels const validPixels = sst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = validPixels['sst'] || 0; console.log(`Valid SST pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid SST pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate temperature gradient // Using Sobel edge detection to find spatial gradients const sobelX = ee.Kernel.sobel(); const gradX = sst.convolve(sobelX); const gradMag = gradX.abs(); // Get maximum gradient within the zone const maxGradient = gradMag.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const gradient = maxGradient['sst'] || null; // Check temperature range (min-max as proxy for gradient) const tempStats = sst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.minMax(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const minTemp = tempStats['sst_min']; const maxTemp = tempStats['sst_max']; if (minTemp === null || maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || minTemp === undefined) { console.log('Invalid temperature values retrieved.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const tempRange = maxTemp - minTemp; console.log(`SST Range: ${minTemp.toFixed(2)}°C to ${maxTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature Gradient (Range): ${tempRange.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Max Spatial Gradient: ${gradient !== null ? gradient.toFixed(4) : 'N/A'}`); // 6. Interpretation: Gradient >5°C suggests sharp thermal fronts // Cabo Frio is known for upwelling, creating strong SST fronts if (tempRange > 5.0) { console.log('Temperature gradient >5°C detected within 10km zone.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No temperature gradient >5°C within 10km zone.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
